games.name: Flood Escape: Classic
games.desc:
Locked in a flooding facility, you and your team must work together to push buttons, find the way out, crack the code and escape before the flood takes you!

Flood Escape Classic started development in September 2011, and is what kickstarted the Flood Escape series.

FEC persisted through many of Roblox's fundamental changes; Mobile Support, Dynamic Lighting, Filtering Enabled and many more.

While the game doesn't get updated often now due to focus on FE2, FEC's continued community and player count shows that the game continues to offer a solid experience for obby enthusiasts.

Flood Escape © Crazyblox Games 2011 - 2024

games.name: [Valentines + Skins] Critical Legends
games.desc:
Critical Legends is now officially discontinued. However, the game will not be shutting down.
I've simply reached a point where I want to move on and focus on other projects and interests. Please don't be angry or disappointed. Sometimes the healthiest decision a creator can make is to move forward when a project no longer brings them fulfillment.

I hope you can understand my decision.
To everyone who has played, supported, contributed to, or simply been part of this community:

Thank you.

Thank you for the memories, the support, and for making Critical Legends what it became.


[v4.0.2]
Full log in our server

Enter the captivating realm of Critical Legends, where epic adventures shape timeless legacies. Traverse forbidden terrain, face exotic foes, and emerge as a legend. Trading within this world is an art—use "!trade USERNAME" in Roblox chat, waiting two minutes between trades. All thanks to the visionary Radi Studios, the architects of this wondrous realm!

games.name: Beat Up Dummies Simulator
games.desc:
Beat up dummies with a variety of weapons and combos to achieve blows which can be used to unlock better weapons to beat up dummies (and players) with. Defeat bosses and complete quests to unlock unique special weapons to further enhance your combative abilities.
Group for questions/updates: https://www.roblox.com/groups/10406903/Funny-Combat-Group#!/about

Notes:
- DELETING BADGES OBTAINED FROM THIS GAME MAY ERASE DATA.
- IF YOUR DATA IS RESET, PLEASE LEAVE & REJOIN IMMEDIATELY
- This game is developed by only one person. Updates may take a while or longer than anticipated.
- It's suggested, but not mandatory to play on PC. Playing on other devices may be difficult.
- Some updates/fixes may be imperfect. This game is prone to bugs and oversights.
- Yes, I am aware there are games with similar names to this one. This game is not an attempt to rip-off those of similarity to it.

Special thanks to those who helped with ideas, testing updates, and reporting bugs.
